segments.text: So these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
This kindled the anger of Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram. He burned with anger against Job for justifying himself rather than God,
and he burned with anger against Job’s three friends because they had failed to refute Job, and yet had condemned him.
Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job because the others were older than he.
But when he saw that the three men had no further reply, his anger was kindled.
So Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite declared: “I am young in years, while you are old; that is why I was timid and afraid to tell you what I know.
I thought that age should speak, and many years should teach wisdom.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text:
But there is a spirit in a man, the breath of the Almighty,
that gives him understanding.
segments.speaker: Elihu

footnotes.text: + Or the Spirit; also in verse 18

segments.text: It is not only the old who are wise, or the elderly who understand justice.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Therefore I say, ‘Listen to me; I too will declare what I know.’
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Indeed, I waited while you spoke; I listened to your reasoning; as you searched for words,
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: I paid you full attention. But no one proved Job wrong; not one of you rebutted his arguments.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: So do not claim, ‘We have found wisdom; let God, not man, refute him.’
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: But Job has not directed his words against me, and I will not answer him with your arguments.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Job’s friends are dismayed, with no more to say; words have escaped them.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Must I wait, now that they are silent, now that they stand and no longer reply?
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: I too will answer; yes, I will declare what I know.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: For I am full of words, and my spirit within me compels me.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: Behold, my belly is like unvented wine; it is about to burst like a new wineskin.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: I must speak and find relief; I must open my lips and respond.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: I will be partial to no one, nor will I flatter any man.
segments.speaker: Elihu

segments.text: For I do not know how to flatter, or my Maker would remove me in an instant.
segments.speaker: Elihu
